record.field:
🌃 NEON MIRAGE

📍 United States | 📅 December 27

Lights up. Bass drops. Neon Mirage takes over the stage for a high-energy electronic set designed to move the crowd from the first beat to the last. Expect pulsing synths, euphoric drops, and an atmosphere built for the dancefloor. This is not a sit-down show — come ready to move. 💃🕺

🎤 About the Artists

Neon Mirage is an electronic duo known for blending house, synthwave, and festival-ready anthems. Their live sets are immersive audiovisual experiences, built around lights, energy, and crowd interaction.

🎵 Setlist Preview

  1. Electric Skyline ⚡
  2. Mirage (Intro)
  3. Neon Nights
  4. Afterglow
  5. Digital Heartbeat 💓
  6. Sunrise Set (closing anthem)

🛍️ Merch Available on Site

  • Glow-in-the-dark tour tee 👕✨
  • Neon Mirage snapback
  • LED wristband (given at entry) 💡
  • Digital setlist download card

🎟️ Doors open: 9:00 PM | Show starts: 10:00 PM

🎉 Party crowd approved — full lighting show and DJ set included.

🤠 MIDNIGHT FALCONS

📍 United States | 📅 December 27

Grit meets heart. Midnight Falcons bring their signature blend of country storytelling and folk harmony to the stage for a night full of twang, soul, and songs that hit close to home. Expect tight vocal harmonies, warm guitar tones, and lyrics that feel like old letters from home.

🎤 About the Artists

Formed on the back porches of the American South, Midnight Falcons are a duo known for their raw honesty and old-soul sound. Their live shows are as much about connection as they are about music.

🎵 Setlist Preview

  1. Dust and Gravel
  2. Two Trains
  3. Hollow Roads
  4. Slow Burn 🔥
  5. Midnight Falcons (Title Track)
  6. Home Ain't a Place

🛍️ Merch Available on Site

  • Signed vinyl — Dust and Gravel
  • Trucker cap 🧢
  • Flannel-inspired tour shirt 👕
  • Leather guitar pick set 🎸

🎟️ Doors open: 6:30 PM | Show starts: 7:30 PM

🎶 Bring your boots — this one's built for singing along.

record.field:
🎸 SOLSTICE ECHOES

📍 United States | 📅 December 27

Step into a night wrapped in candlelight and raw acoustic soul. Solstice Echoes returns to the stage for an intimate performance that strips music down to its purest form — just voice, strings, and story. Known for their emotionally-charged songwriting and hypnotic melodies, this is a show for those who want to feel every lyric.

🎤 About the Artist

Solstice Echoes is the solo project born from years of songwriting in quiet rooms and late-night studio sessions. Blending folk, indie, and singer-songwriter influences, their sound has been described as "a warm fire on a cold night."

🎵 Setlist Preview

  1. Ashen Hours
  2. Quiet Static
  3. Wildfire Heart (fan favorite)
  4. Paper Moons
  5. Solstice (Acoustic Version)
  6. Where the Light Goes

🛍️ Merch Available on Site

  • Solstice Echoes vinyl LP — Ashen Hours
  • Embroidered beanie 🧢
  • Tour tee (black & cream) 👕
  • Limited edition tote bag

🎟️ Doors open: 7:00 PM | Show starts: 8:00 PM

🔥 Don't miss this one — limited seating for an intimate acoustic setup.
